lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns and three horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are visible posterior to the gill region, forming a grid-like arrangement with variable spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming anchor nodes that define a clear rectangular grid topology on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running parallel across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high (top) to low (bottom).

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, lower-intensity high-luminance blobs that decrease in size towards the posterior trailing edge.
